findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: claim_check, catalog_readiness, listing_build, marketplace_image_brief, amazon_backend_search_terms, compliance_scan, competitor_research · Private data: catalog_readiness, omnichannel_pack · Public sink: title_optimizer, listing_title_variants, bullet_rewriter, product_description_html, category_node_suggester, claim_check, catalog_readiness, listing_audit, listing_build, ppc_kit, omnichannel_pack, marketplace_ads_kit, marketplace_image_brief, review_response, a_plus_content_brief, keyword_gap, amazon_backend_search_terms, image_alt_text_pack, pricing_what_if, promotion_profit_guard, compliance_scan, bulk_csv_audit, brand_name_screen, holiday_copy_refresh, competitor_change_monitor, email_flow_pack, walmart_rich_media_brief, ebay_item_specifics, variation_family_plan, return_reason_analysis, restock_plan, listing_appeal, competitor_research, marketplace_upload_starter_pack · Destructive: marketplace_upload_starter_pack.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
